about: Words masked with * in chat (server only). Whole words, matched case-insensitively after the substitutions below, so 'Sh1t' and '$hit' match 'shit' but 'shitake' doesn't. List each form you want caught (fuck, fucking, fucker). Keep it short and obvious: a word that is also an everyday word or a name (dick, cock, prick) masks innocent chat. See docs/architecture/world-server.md, 'Local chat'.
